candidates.review_note: Use row-profile exact domino tiling DP. The incoming vertical-domino mask and previous row horizontal-domino mask identify whether each vertex between two rows already lies inside a domino. If none of its two vertical edges nor upper horizontal edge lies inside a domino, the current horizontal edge is forced; otherwise four distinct mats would meet there. Reject overlapping forced horizontal dominoes or conflicts with incoming cells. Fill remaining cells by downwards vertical or rightwards horizontal dominoes, recording both masks for the next row. The first row has no above-row vertices; the last permits no downward domino. Each tiling is generated exactly once, and the local no-four-corners rule is necessary and sufficient for the stated tatami constraint. Rotate dimensions only to reduce frontier width, preserving the count.
